Summarise Victorian Public Transport Patronage

Source: R/summarise_daily_patronage.R
summarise_daily_patronage.Rd

Calculate the mean of reported average daily patronage values across selected transport modes, day types and reporting years.

Usage

summarise_daily_patronage(
  data = NULL,
  modes = NULL,
  day_types = NULL,
  years = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing patronage observations. Defaults to the bundled patronage dataset.

modes

Character vector of transport modes to include. NULL (default) includes all available modes.

day_types

Character vector of day types to include. NULL (default) includes all available day types.

years

Numeric vector of length two specifying the inclusive reporting-year range. NULL (default) includes all available years.

Value

A tibble containing mode, day_type, day_of_week, mean_daily_patronage and n_observations.

Details

The function first filters the data according to the selected modes, day types and years. It then groups observations by transport mode, day type and day of the week.

The summary is an unweighted mean of reported average daily patronage values across the selected reporting months. It should not be interpreted as total monthly patronage.

Examples

# Summarise all transport modes
summarise_daily_patronage()
#> # A tibble: 60 × 5
#>    mode             day_type     day_of_week mean_daily_patronage n_observations
#>    <chr>            <chr>        <ord>                      <dbl>          <int>
#>  1 Metropolitan bus Normal Week… Monday                   329452.             93
#>  2 Metropolitan bus Normal Week… Tuesday                  350910.             93
#>  3 Metropolitan bus Normal Week… Wednesday                354643.             96
#>  4 Metropolitan bus Normal Week… Thursday                 355585.             95
#>  5 Metropolitan bus Normal Week… Friday                   334818.             94
#>  6 Metropolitan bus School Holi… Monday                   261829.             45
#>  7 Metropolitan bus School Holi… Tuesday                  275412.             46
#>  8 Metropolitan bus School Holi… Wednesday                281623.             46
#>  9 Metropolitan bus School Holi… Thursday                 282570.             46
#> 10 Metropolitan bus School Holi… Friday                   259965.             42
#> # ℹ 50 more rows

# Compare normal weekdays for metropolitan trains
summarise_daily_patronage(
  modes = "Metropolitan train",
  day_types = "Normal Weekday"
)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 5
#>   mode               day_type    day_of_week mean_daily_patronage n_observations
#>   <chr>              <chr>       <ord>                      <dbl>          <int>
#> 1 Metropolitan train Normal Wee… Monday                   495766.             93
#> 2 Metropolitan train Normal Wee… Tuesday                  556234.             93
#> 3 Metropolitan train Normal Wee… Wednesday                563695.             96
#> 4 Metropolitan train Normal Wee… Thursday                 569149.             95
#> 5 Metropolitan train Normal Wee… Friday                   538652.             94

# Examine tram patronage from 2022 to 2025
summarise_daily_patronage(
  modes = "Tram",
  years = c(2022, 2025)
)
#> # A tibble: 12 × 5
#>    mode  day_type               day_of_week mean_daily_patronage n_observations
#>    <chr> <chr>                  <ord>                      <dbl>          <int>

#>  5 Tram  Normal Weekday         Friday                   457550              45

#>  8 Tram  School Holiday Weekday Wednesday                420976.             23
